body:
The existing stack importer discarded legacy GitHub StatusContext.state, so SUCCESS, FAILURE and ERROR all became pending. Preserve these outcomes when creating stack metadata: SUCCESS maps to success; FAILURE/ERROR map to failure; pending, missing and unknown legacy states stay pending. Existing CheckRun policy and graph topology are unchanged; existing cards are not refreshed. No watcher, auto-approval or merge action is added.

PR307 was user-merged at de43f47c29d5c08ae6e6c5eb366767320ffcdd0c. This now targets main at 6d97897325efdeea47d86f3ae169c72907b74d6e; its tree is unchanged from the previous b4a candidate. Fresh actual-main validation and CI40977980388 are in progress; keep Draft until complete. Includes the previously published central receipts.

Validation:
- Same 33 author tests: old source 12 failures/21 passes, repaired 33 passes. Independently frozen 36 vectors: old 9 failures, repaired 36 passes; injected runner verifies ingest/drift/topology without live GitHub or DB writes.
- Full at bda3942a: 22 packages, 7207 passed/5 skipped/0 failed; 8562 tracked file bytes unchanged during the run, with four fresh generated dist files initially dirty. Later parent lint integration separately passed 172 GitHub/14 CLI tests, lint/build and changeset coverage. This is not a final clean-tree full claim.
- Actual Claude CLI Sonnet 5.5 static PASS; optional findings and pre-existing out-of-scope CheckRun gaps retained. Final docs 241 and hygiene 1 passed; published-head CI remains pending.
- Original failures, source bindings and raw audits preserved in docs/implementation/stack-status-context; all 133 archive members independently checked.

PS18 contribution; PS17/J07 support; J20 design context only. No whole capability or formal milestone is marked complete.
title: fix(github): preserve legacy status outcomes during stack ingestion
